title: When the Verdict Burns Again
author: Marguerite Nystrom
blurb: Oscar Iversen, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
